authorization: 2026-10-29 user explicitly requests new directions, multiple methods and preliminary feasibility training; all basic metrics and generalization must meet declared targets.

input_pointer.directory: 全量文献训练数据接入_v7_药渣与地肤主集_20261029

selection_policy: Scopes and curve anchoring chosen by scientific input availability and independent counts, not favorable held-out scores. Existing literature/labels were previously viewed; exploratory feasibility, no untouched prospective validation.

criteria.generalization: Whole source-family holdout; calibrated routes permit only predeclared target-curve anchors. Source bootstrap 2000 intervals; report source-wise and curve-normalized diagnostics. Truly prospective new-source validation remains required for final reliability, not claimed by this experiment.

threshold_basis: Engineering goals, not a universal standard. Biomass-carbon J Energy Storage S2352152X2402560X reports R2 .951, MAE11.090, RMSE14.756; target MAE10/RMSE15 deliberately demanding, plus relative errors and source validation. Retention1/1.5pp is a provisional design goal rather than a published universal cutoff.

routes.name: 限定工况的零实测比电容预测
routes.validation: Leave one entire source family out; no target-source capacitance or sample identity input. Fit only training-fold encoding and imputation.

routes.name: 一个低倍率实测点+跨来源归一化迁移
routes.validation: Leave source out; other sources train C/C_low from log(j/j_low), C_low and static material features. The new material has exactly its minimum-current capacitance anchor; test all other currents.

routes.name: 三个预定倍率实测点补全中间倍率
routes.validation: Per curve anchor indices 0,(n-1)//2,n-1, determined only by sorted currents. Test remaining currents, never score anchors. Independent new curves may be calibrated with those three measurements. All normalized-curve and author-only sensitivities retained.

routes.name: 三个低电流点外推高电流
routes.validation: Per curve anchor first three currents; predict all higher currents. All eligible curves kept, no selection on errors.

routes.name: 只用制备参数预测BET或同家族插值
routes.validation: BET process-only >=3 nonmissing process fields. Both leave-source-out and leave-material-out within sources with>=5 materials; latter assumes known family/protocol and is not unseen-source generalization.

routes.name: 保留循环任务但限制6M KOH
routes.validation: New narrowed task leave source out; keep difficult records and true >100 labels, no inherited old training plan rerun.

stop: One frozen pass of named scopes/models; no hyperparameter search, no stacking selected on outer outcomes, no added scopes after seeing scores. Maximum1200 estimator/calibration fits; invalid runs stop, failures preserved. No global packages or pretrained weights installed/downloaded, LightGBM and TabPFN noted as untested resource options.
